entry_item.definition: n., adj., adv., and postpos. Middle, center; half; central; average, moderate, temperate; in the middle, among.

example.definition: To be neutral, impartial; to take an average; to keep a happy medium.
Center, middle;. Middlel Kingdom, central, i.e. China.
Halfway; half of the place or region.
In the middle of the court.
To mediate between two parties, act as go-between.
vaisseau qui se trouve au milieu de la mer
centre, milieu; 2 province centrale; 3 royaume du milieu, partic. Mâgadha (Behar méridionale); Inde centrale; 4 Tibet central où se trouve la ville capitale Lhassa
